title: Keys and Rooms
statement: `rooms[i]` is the list of keys found in room i. You start in room 0. Return true when you can visit every room.
hints: This is reachability from node 0 in a directed graph.
A key lets you traverse an edge. Finding the key again does not matter.
Visit a room at most once. Compare the visited count with n.

approaches.name: DFS
approaches.explanation: Mark rooms as you enter them.

approaches.name: BFS
approaches.explanation: A queue of newly opened rooms.

editorial: Start at room 0 with it marked visited. For every key inside a visited room, if that room is new, visit it. The search ends when no new keys lead anywhere. Success is visiting n rooms.

examples.explanation: Room 2 is locked from the outside and holds its own key.
